Those defaults feel right: keep a private viewable copy automatically, while making the public Internet Archive copy an explicit choice. Please make it clear that the Internet Archive option creates a public copy before I enable it.

The small card actions work well, including “Save a copy” when one wasn’t captured initially. The preserved web-page copy should be self-contained so it remains viewable even if the original changes or disappears; PDFs should retain the PDF itself.

I’m comfortable approving this proposed behaviour with simulated copies for now. During the real build, if capturing fails, the bookmark should still save and clearly offer a way to try the copy again.
